name: fuzzy-eureka-d2-data
description: Searchable Destiny 2 data compiled from community spreadsheets, with a synergy-aware build planner.

scripts.data: python3 tools/fetch_sheets.py && node tools/bungie-weapons.mjs && node tools/bungie-icons.mjs && python3 tools/build_data.py
scripts.deploy: npm run build && gh-pages -d dist --dotfiles -m "Deploy site"
scripts.data:bungie: node tools/bungie-weapons.mjs && node tools/bungie-icons.mjs && python3 tools/build_data.py
